Cold, Claude and Sonnet only; never automatic; never /model in a pane. One coder, two review rounds (C34).

value.claim: One explicit verb compacts a cold Claude seat on Sonnet 5.5 (for example `pij compact <seat> --cheap`, or revive with a model followed by the existing compact command, whichever is simpler). It restarts the seat with `--resume --model <sonnet 5.5 id>`, runs the normal compaction through the existing gates, and leaves the seat on Sonnet. It never types /model into a pane (in-session /model rewrites Jordan's global default in Claude settings.json). pij's recorded model (boundModel) shows Sonnet afterwards.

Cold seats only, Claude only, Sonnet only. A warm seat is refused in one line (warm seats already get the cache discount, so a normal compact is cheaper). A non-Claude seat is refused in one line (Copilot bills per request, so the benefit is unproven). The model is Sonnet 5.5, never Haiku (its 200k window can't hold these seats).

It is an option, never automatic: only an explicit call by the prime (or the PA when the prime asks) runs it. No watchdog, PA sweep or threshold triggers it. Going back to Opus is a separate explicit step (revive with the Opus model), done only when the seat takes on hard work again.

Docs: one short entry in the PA brief and in skills/pij/references/routes/community.md: when to use it (a cold Claude seat over about 300k that must come back), that it's the prime's call, and how to go back to Opus.

Cost (AGENTS.md, resource cost is a correctness property). No loop, timer or poll. One seat restart per explicit use. No new launch site per tick; any new launch site is recorded in crates/testkit/tests/spawn_sites.rs.

Docs and states. PA brief and skills/pij/references/routes/community.md: one entry each (when, whose call, how to go back). docs/how/pij-rs-api.md documents new verbs and refusals; the skill's verb coverage tables carry them; `just ddocs-check` and `ddocs validate` on the project docs pass; the PR body has a `Delivers:` line.

sections.name: research_context
sections.value: Jordan approved on 2026-11-09: 'yes have it built, only for cold seats and its an option'. Earlier rules, 2026-10-01 (Unasphere prime session): 'for seats that are old and uncache that we want to revivie to ask questions or compact we can consuer sonner 5.5'; 'lets leave first class switching out for now'; back to Opus 'only if it then takes on hard work'. Analysis: ~/games/unasphere/scratch/usage-blowout/cold-seat-model-switch.md, section 4 thresholds (300k+ pays) and section 5 (Jordan's pattern): switching every cold seat would have lost money because most went back to Opus within the hour, so option only. Plan 161's POC branch plan-161-model-switch-poc has the per-harness restart-with-model method. Traps from last time: never type /model into a pane (it rewrites the global default; pa.md already says so); update boundModel after the switch or pij list lies.

value.risk: Two lanes edit the same CLI wiring or skill files.
value.mitigation: Rebase onto main before the PR; small diffs at the seam; pm-001 orders merges.

sections.name: execution_guardrails
value: Tests use scratch repos and a private daemon; never the live governance branch or the prod daemon.
Builds: your own target or `just shared-build`; CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; -p scoping; stop under 25 GB free.
No `git add -A`, no `--no-verify`; no node_modules, never symlinked (C25); TS proof is CI on the exact head.
Shared seams (crates/cli wiring, skills/pij): rebase onto main before the PR and keep edits minimal; don't fork the seam.
One push per review round; no pushes after the PR is out for verdicts unless a verdict asks.
